events.title: Volunteer Away Your Fines as a Branch Buddy

cases.refreshed: Every now and then, libraries need a little extra love from the communities they serve. Volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Volunteers are needed to help with: Tables and Chairs Cleaning – Wipe down crucial furniture used for library events; Book Cover Cleaning – Use disinfecting wipes to reinvigorate dingy books; Material Inspection – Check books for torn pages, pen marks, etc. Details and Requirements: Must be able to commit to the full session; Anyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardian; No experience or special skills necessary. To register, please call 408-808-3043 or email je.sjpl@sjlibrary.org

cases.refreshed: Learn the basics of creating a successful resume in this 15-minute introductory session with a Librarian. Topics will include common resume formats, organizing your experience, and how to use keywords from job descriptions to strengthen your resume. After the introductory session, participants may have brief one-on-one time with the Librarian for a quick overview of their resume, as time allows. Participants needing more in-depth resume assistance may be referred to SJPL Works for additional support. Participants are encouraged to bring a copy of their resume and a job description they are interested in applying for.

cases.refreshed: Do you have pile of clothing you've been meaning to repair, but don't know where to start? Are you looking to test out a sewing machine? Learn clothing alteration and repair basics to adjust your clothes, stuffed animals, and secondhand finds. Bring in 1-2 items of clothing you would like to mend, and receive hands-on sewing instruction. Alterations & Mending: replace buttons; fix tears or holes; shorten hems; cover stains; & more. Limited colors of thread, fabric scraps, and buttons available. For a perfect match, please bring your own materials.

cases.refreshed: Drop by the Cupertino Library Children's Room starting at 11:00 a.m. until 5:00 p.m. and enjoy all of your favorite board games. We have Monopoly, Scrabble, Clue, Sorry!, Twister, puzzles, card games and more! Play with a friend or make a new friend! Generously sponsored by the Friends of Cupertino Library. For accessibility accommodations (e.g., ASL), please fill out the online form at sccld.org/accessibility 7+ days prior to the event. If you need assistance with the form, speak with a staff member at your local library, call (408) 540-3947, or email us at ask@lib.sccgov.org.

cases.refreshed: Every now and then, libraries need a little extra love from the communities they serve. You can volunteer away your library fines at a rate of $20 per hour while helping the library maintain a clean and welcoming environment. Volunteers will help with: Book cover cleaning – Use disinfecting wipes to reinvigorate dingy books. Bookshelves – Dust shelves and organize library materials. Deep cleaning computers – Use disinfecting wipes to disinfect computer mice and mouse pads and compressed air to remove any dust particles or debris. Material inspection – Check books for torn pages, pen marks, etc. This is a perfect opportunity for anyone interested in volunteering away their library fines. Details and Requirements: Must be able to commit to the full session; Anyone under the age of 15 must volunteer alongside a parent/guardian; No experience or special skills necessary; Training and supplies will be provided; Must arrive no later than 10 minutes late. Space is limited.
